instruction: CLI-only OpenSCAD quantified structural-proxy task. Run OpenSCAD from `/usr/bin/openscad` when working on `starter.scad`. Work from /home/user/Desktop/starter.scad, /home/user/Desktop/baseline.stl, and /home/user/Desktop/constraints.json. Use OpenSCAD command-line modeling and export, not a GUI. Edit starter.scad or create a derived OpenSCAD source, then export /home/user/Desktop/optimized.stl and write /home/user/Desktop/design_summary.json. Produce one watertight, winding-consistent, edge-connected positive-volume cable-tray bridge inside x=[0,130], y=[0,38], z=[0,45] mm, with bounding spans at least [124,32,36] mm and volume between 52000 and 98000 mm^3. Structural proxy assumptions: isotropic linear-elastic material E=2000 N/mm^2 and allowable bending stress 12 MPa; simple supports at x=2 and x=128 mm on the z=0 underside; a 100 N downward center load introduced through two top bearing patches, x=[62,68] mm and y=[5,9] plus y=[29,33] mm, at z>=40 mm. Each support contact zone x=[0,5] and x=[125,130] mm must provide at least 170 mm^2 of actual z=0 contact, and each top load patch must provide at least 20 mm^2. The evaluator rasterizes connected Y-Z material sections every 2.5 mm from x=5 through x=125, calculates vertical-bending I_y, and uses the minimum effective section. Every sampled section must be one connected load path, minimum I_y must be at least 75000 mm^4, Euler-Bernoulli center deflection P*L^3/(48*E*I_min) for L=126 mm must not exceed 0.03 mm, and calculated bending stress must not exceed 12 MPa. After hard constraints, maximize calculated bending stiffness 48*E*I_min/L^3 divided by material volume. This is an explicitly defined beam-theory geometry proxy, not finite-element certification. Sparse extremal or non-load-bearing geometry does not improve the score. This is a continuous optimization task, not a hidden-shape matching task. Use only the supplied task inputs; do not use evaluator-generated artifacts or evaluator implementation files, and do not fabricate metrics without a valid STL.
